events.verdict: Okogie (CHA) makes clean contact with the ball to steal the pass away from James (LAL).
Davis (LAL) briefly touches Okogie's (CHA) body as he elevates for the dunk and the contact is marginal.
Green (CHA) rests a hand on Reaves' (LAL) body, which he immediately removes as Reaves begins his shooting motion. There is no illegal contact during Reaves' shot attempt.
Reaves (LAL) is moving alongside Bridges' (CHA) path to the basket before making clean contact with the ball to dislodge it from his possession.
Bridges (CHA) jumps vertically to contest Finney-Smith's (LAL) dunk attempt and the ensuing contact is incidental.
Davis (LAL) moves alongside Bridges' (CHA) path to the basket and when he is beaten to the spot, the body contact is marginal.
Williams (CHA) maintains an arm to Finney-Smith's (LAL) front, but immediately releases it as he attempts to move to set the pick.
Okogie (CHA) fumbles the ball upon receiving the pass and legally recovers the loose ball.
Bridges (CHA) splits the defenders during his driving shot attempt and the contact from both Finney-Smith (LAL) and Reaves (LAL) is marginal.
Bridges (CHA) places his hand on Finney-Smith's (LAL) body as he releases in the opposite direction and Finney-Smith's momentum carries him forwards.
Williams (CHA) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds. Possession should be awarded to Los Angeles instead of Charlotte.
Christie (LAL) cleanly blocks Okogie's (CHA) jump shot attempt.
Green (CHA) is out of bounds when he makes contact with the ball to steal it from Davis (LAL).
Davis (LAL) jumps forwards when he closes out during Green's (CHA) jump shot attempt and he initiates illegal lower body contact with Green as he returns to the floor.
Diabate (CHA) commits a take foul on Davis (LAL).
Reaves (LAL) legally contests Bridges' (CHA) jump shot attempt.
